properties.notes: The site was allocated for residential development in the 2007 SSAL policy AL1 and is within the built up area of Horsham town meaning it is considered suitable for development. An application for 37 dwellings (DC/17/1853) was refused in December 2018. It should be noted that the application covers a larger area than the allocation as it also includes 15 Crawley Road.
